author: Karl Rock
description:
I tried Sindhi biryani for the first time in Karachi… and it’s nothing like the biryani I’ve had in India!!

Everyone talks about Hyderabadi biryani from India, but people here told me Sindhi biryani is spicier, tangier, and way more intense - so I went to Allah Wala Biryani to find out if it actually lives up to the hype.

From the way it’s cooked in massive pots to the unique ingredients like dried plums, this biryani completely surprised me.

So… is Sindhi biryani better than Hyderabadi? Watch till the end to find out.

Have you tried Hyderabadi, Bengali, and Sindhi biryani? Which was your favourite?
